entries.name: AppShell
entries.purpose: The frame of an app, in the two manners that pair: `solid` — the structured frame, a solid TopBar over a Sidebar and the content beside it — and `floating` — the TopBar floating over the top edge, a Rail standing on the background, and the content living in the rounded card.

props.name: menu
props.note: The top bar's menu button, in an app whose navigation collapses.

props.name: logo
props.note: The top bar's left: the app's logo mark, or its name as text.

props.name: search
props.note: The top bar's centre — a search field, when there is one.

props.name: identity
props.note: The top bar's right cluster — an `IdentityMenu`.

props.name: banner
props.note: A `Banner`, or nothing — drawn at the top of the content area.

props.name: nav
props.note: The navigation: a `Sidebar` in the solid manner, a `Rail` in the floating one.

looks: overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-bg-surface signal:border signal:border-border-subtle signal:shadow-highlight-inset

entries.name: AttachmentCard
entries.purpose: Something attached — a document or an image — drawn as a card: posted, or waiting to be sent.

props.name: name
props.note: The name it was attached under, extension included: it decides the icon and the type label.

props.name: size
props.note: In bytes.

props.name: contentType
props.note: Its MIME type, where known: an `image/…` type is an image whatever its name.

props.name: href
props.note: Where a document opens, in a new tab. Without it the row is dimmed and opens nothing.

props.name: src
props.note: The picture an image card draws. Without it an image is drawn as a row.

props.name: alt
props.note: What the picture shows, where the sender said — Ship carries one on every `imeta`.

props.name: remoteSrc
props.note: A file the app has to *fetch* before it can be used — one on a relay, where reading it needs the reader's own authorization (UIG-35).

props.name: remoteFullSrc
props.note: The full-size picture, fetched only when someone opens it.

props.name: fetchImage
props.note: How this app fetches a picture it is allowed to read: a URL in, a URL the browser can draw out (an object URL, usually).

props.name: onOpen
props.note: What a click on an image's picture does.

props.name: onDownload
props.note: Shows a download control on hover or focus, and calls this.

props.name: download
props.note: Shows the download control and saves the file itself, under `name`: the original where there is one (`remoteFullSrc`), otherwise what the card is drawing.

props.name: pending
props.note: Waiting to be sent: the composer's 200px row, with a remove control on its corner.

props.name: onRemove
props.note: Removes a pending card.

props.name: state
props.takes: ready | loading | unreadable | uploading | failed | warning
props.note: `ready` · `loading` (an image on its way) · `unreadable` (it could not be read) · `uploading`, `failed`, `warning` (while pending).

props.name: note
props.note: The line under the name, in place of its type and size — why it failed, or what the warning is.

props.name: noteHint
props.note: The note's full words, on hover, where the line is short.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Avatar
entries.purpose: A person's face: their picture, or their initials on a colour that is theirs, or — when there is no name to take initials from — a silhouette.

props.name: src
props.note: The picture URL, resolved by the caller.

props.name: name
props.note: The person's name — where the initials and the colour come from.

props.name: alt
props.note: Alt text for the picture; the name when absent.

props.name: size
props.note: Pixels. The scale: 16 · 24 · 32 · 36 (default).

props.name: label
props.note: Say the person's name out loud, for a face that stands on its own — `PersonTrigger`'s compact shape, a stack of members.

entries.name: AvatarGroup
entries.purpose: Up to three overlapping 24px faces with a surface-coloured ring — the member stack for anywhere a group is shown at a glance.

props.name: size
props.note: Face size in pixels; the overlap follows it. 24 is the members pill, 18 the replies row (Katerina, 2026-09-03) — that row drew its own stack for two months for want of this one number, and drifted while it did.

entries.name: Banner
entries.purpose: The strip under the header where the app says something happened: one line, one of four tones, gone when there is nothing to say.

props.name: children
props.note: The one line. Text, or text with a name in `font-medium`.

props.name: icon
props.note: A 16px icon before the line, in the tone's colour (Katerina, 2026-09-18: Peek's composer strip became a Banner).

props.name: action
props.note: The one thing to do: the package's Button, muted and small, at the end of the line.

props.name: onDismiss
props.note: Adds an `✕` at the right-hand end. Absent: the app removes the banner.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.note: The dismiss button's accessible name. Defaults to "Dismiss".

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Breadcrumb
entries.purpose: A trail: where you are, and the way back up.

entries.name: Button
entries.purpose: The push-button for an action: a verb, clicked once — "Create", "Save", "Delete".

props.name: leadingIcon
props.note: 16px, stroke 1.5 on the default size; 14px on small.

props.name: disabledReason
props.note: Why the action cannot succeed right now.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Card
entries.purpose: A box that stands for one thing — drawn as its frame: 8px corners, a fill and a hairline.

props.name: fill
props.note: What the card sits on. Default `surface`.

props.name: href
props.note: The whole card is a link: an anchor, and its hairline answers the pointer.

props.name: hover
props.note: How it answers the pointer. Default `hairline` with an `href`, `none` without.

props.name: quietUntilHover
props.note: No hairline until it is pointed at — a row in a feed that shows its edge only when you are on it.

props.name: hovered
props.note: Draw the hover look now, whatever the pointer does.

props.name: selected
props.note: The one you are on: the selected fill, a subtle hairline, and no hover.

props.name: active
props.note: Being changed in place: the selected fill with the accent hairline, and no hover.

props.name: attention
props.note: A hairline that asks to be looked at — something new (`accent`), or urgent (`warning`).

props.name: unreadable
props.note: It stands for something that could not be read: the hairline is dashed.

props.name: clip
props.note: What is inside is cut to the card's rounded corners: a strip or a picture that runs edge to edge (UIG-9, 17 September; the apps passed `overflow-hidden`).

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.purpose: A 16px square that fills with the accent when checked.

props.name: label
props.note: Words beside the box. With `onChange`, clicking them toggles it too, and they name it, so no `aria-label` is needed.

props.name: row
props.note: The whole row is the target: `leading`, then the words, then the box at the end; the row fills on hover and while checked.

props.name: leading
props.note: In a `row`, a picture before the words: an icon, a status.

props.name: aria-required
props.note: Set by a `Field` with `required`; a caller inside one owes nothing.

entries.name: Chip
entries.purpose: A 20px pill for a small piece of standing information — a status, a count, a category — in one of six colour types.

props.name: type
props.takes: neutral | brand | info | warning | success | error

entries.name: ChipInput
entries.purpose: A multi-select input: chips for the chosen, a typeahead for the rest.

props.name: options
props.note: The directory the typeahead searches.

props.name: excludeIds
props.note: Option ids excluded from the suggestion list (e.g., the current user).

props.name: chipLeading
props.note: Before a chip's label, 16px — a face, an icon.

props.name: rowLeading
props.note: Before a suggestion row's label, 32px.

props.name: aria-required
props.note: Set by a `Field` with `required`; a caller inside one owes nothing.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: The field's name, for a caller that is not inside a `Field` — a `Field`'s label names it already.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.note: The id of what names the field on the page — a visible "To:", say.

entries.name: cn
entries.purpose: Merge class names, last-one-wins on conflicting Tailwind utilities.

entries.name: CollapsibleSection
entries.purpose: A section that opens and closes: a SectionHeader whose title is the toggle, and the rows under it, sliding shut and open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.note: Open unless told otherwise.

props.name: open
props.note: The caller owns the state.

props.name: storageKey
props.note: Remember open or closed in this browser, under this key.

props.name: trailing
props.note: Beside the title and always visible, before the actions — a count.

props.name: actions
props.note: Beside the title, revealed on hover or focus — `SectionHeader`'s.

props.name: children
props.note: The rows.

props.name: className
props.note: On the section's box: `mt-2` between groups, `shrink-0` in a scrolling column.

props.name: contentClassName
props.note: On the box the rows sit in: the gap between them.

entries.name: CommandPalette
entries.purpose: A window that searches and runs things: a field, rows in groups, and a footer naming the keys that work right now.

props.name: label
props.note: The window's name for a screen reader — there is no title on screen.

props.name: where
props.note: The footer's left side: where the palette was opened from.

props.name: modKey
props.note: How the footer spells the modifier in `Ctrl+Backspace` and `Ctrl+Enter` — `Cmd` on a Mac.

props.name: children
props.note: One level: a `CommandPaletteSearch` or a `CommandPaletteForm`.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Floats on top of the page
Holds focus inside while open, and gives it back
Stops the page behind it scrolling
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

looks: overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border-default bg-bg-elevated shadow-lg outline-none

entries.name: CommandPaletteAnswer
entries.purpose: A written answer, with marks that point at the rows it came from.

props.name: children
props.note: The answer's text. A blank line starts a new paragraph, and a number in square brackets — `[1]` — is drawn as a small mark pointing at the row of the same number below.

props.name: note
props.note: A quiet line under the answer — what a key will do now.

entries.name: CommandPaletteForm
entries.purpose: The palette as a form: fields, one submit button, and Ctrl+Enter — both ways in run Base UI's field check.

props.name: chip
props.note: Names what the form makes, and goes back when removed.

props.name: icon
props.note: Before the chip, 16px — the mark of whatever the form writes to.

props.name: submitLabel
props.note: The button's word, and the footer's beside Ctrl+Enter.

props.name: submitWaits
props.note: Why submitting has to wait — nothing changed yet.

props.name: working
props.note: While the thing is being made: the fields lock, the button reads `button`, and `line` says what is happening.

props.name: error
props.note: What went wrong, beside the button.

props.name: children
props.note: The fields, each in a `Field`.

entries.name: CommandPaletteQuote
entries.purpose: Text written to be used elsewhere, set off by a rule at its left edge.

props.name: children
props.note: Text written for someone to use — shown as it will be used, line breaks kept.

entries.name: CommandPaletteSearch
entries.purpose: The palette as a search: a query field, rows in labelled groups walked with the arrow keys, and what to show while nothing has arrived and when nothing matches.

props.name: chip
props.note: The level you are in. Without one, this is the first level and there is nowhere to go back to.

props.name: pending
props.note: A line under the rows while more are on their way — "Searching…".

props.name: notes
props.note: Quiet lines under the rows, for what a person should know about them and cannot act on — "2 more where you cannot open them", "the search was refused, so this list is incomplete".

props.name: empty
props.note: The line when there are no rows. Leave it out while rows are still on their way.

props.name: children
props.note: Above the rows: a `CommandPaletteWorking`, `CommandPaletteAnswer` or `CommandPaletteQuote`.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Floats on top of the page
Moves through its items with the arrow keys

entries.name: CommandPaletteWorking
entries.purpose: A line saying what is being worked on, with grey bars where the result will land.

props.name: children
props.note: What is happening — "Reading 12 messages…".

props.name: bars
props.note: Grey bars under the line, where the result will be.

entries.name: ConfirmDialog
entries.purpose: A question with two answers, asked before something a person would want back.

props.name: children
props.note: The body — plain sentences, body-2.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Floats on top of the page
Holds focus inside while open, and gives it back
Stops the page behind it scrolling
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: ContainerHeader
entries.purpose: The bar across the top of a column — a list, a thread, a side panel: its title, and the buttons that act on the whole column at the right edge. 48px, with a hairline under it.

props.name: title
props.note: A string keeps the one-line treatment; a node is drawn as given.

props.name: chevron
props.note: A chevron after the title, for a title that opens something.

props.name: actions
props.note: The column's own buttons, at the right edge: IconButtons with tooltips, 4px apart.

entries.name: DialogShell
entries.purpose: The dialog, minus what it says: the portal, the backdrop, a 502px card, a 48px header with the title and a close button, a body, and a 48px footer for the buttons.

props.name: title
props.note: Labels the dialog for assistive tech, and renders as the header text unless `headerContent` replaces it.

props.name: headerContent
props.note: Replaces the title text in the header — a back button beside the title, a count chip after it.

props.name: footer
props.note: Absent: no footer row, and the body keeps the card's own bottom edge (a roster that simply ends).

props.name: bodyClassName
props.note: Extra classes on the body: its layout and any padding override (`flex flex-col gap-6`, `p-0 py-2`).

props.name: bodyMaxHeight
props.note: How tall the body may get before it scrolls, as the cap class — `max-h-[400px]`, `max-h-[70vh]`.

props.name: alert
props.note: A question that has to be answered rather than clicked away: a press on the backdrop no longer closes it, and it announces itself as an alert.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Floats on top of the page
Holds focus inside while open, and gives it back
Stops the page behind it scrolling
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Divider
entries.purpose: A hairline in `border-subtle`. Horizontal it is inset 12px each side; `orientation="vertical"` stands it up to its row's height, no inset.

props.name: label
props.note: Words in the middle of the line — "New since you last read this", a date.

props.name: tone
props.note: `warning` for a line that asks for attention: the label in the warning colour, the lines in its wash.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: EditableText
entries.purpose: Text you click to edit. It reads as text until clicked; then it is a field.

props.name: onCommit
props.note: Resolve `true` when saved; `false` (or throw) keeps the field open with the text.

props.name: className
props.note: Applied to both the text and the field, so they are the same size.

props.name: label
props.note: The accessible name of the field — "Title", "Description".

props.name: display
props.note: What to *show* when not editing, when that differs from what is edited — a value carrying a raw reference that the caller renders as a live object below the text, say.

props.name: displayNode
props.note: What to *draw* when not editing, when the value is structured rather than a line of prose.

props.name: readOnly
props.note: Show the value only — no edit affordance.

entries.name: EmptyState
entries.purpose: The place where content will be once there is some, in two manners: a 16px icon over a centred line when the whole page is empty, the line alone and left-aligned when one section of a page is.

props.name: icon
props.note: 16px, stroke 1.5. A speech bubble when absent.

props.name: scope
props.note: `page` when the whole page is empty; `section` when one part of it is.

props.name: action
props.note: The one thing to do about it — "New topic", "Try again" — drawn 16px under the line as the package's Button, outlined (Katerina, 2026-09-18).

entries.name: EnterHint
entries.purpose: The keyboard hint a picker row shows while highlighted — hand-rolled in five files before this (2026-09-01), and drawn as its own thing until 2026-09-05, when it became the `Kbd` chip every other key hint uses.

entries.name: ErrorBoundary
entries.purpose: Keeps a crash inside what it holds: that part shows "Something went wrong … Your data is safe — try again." with a Try again button, and the rest of the page keeps working.

props.name: label
props.note: What it holds, said in the message and the console line: "Something went wrong in the {label}."

props.name: fallbackClassName
props.note: The room the message fills where no flex column holds it — the whole screen, for the app's own.

props.name: frame
props.note: Draws the message inside a frame of yours, in the same place: `ListColumn` keeps its title this way.

entries.name: Field
entries.purpose: A label over a control — the form row. The label is the `input-label` token; `required` marks it with the error-coloured asterisk.

props.name: required
props.note: Draws the asterisk and marks the control `aria-required`, so the mark means something to a reader who cannot see it.

props.name: helper
props.note: A hint under the control — what the format is, what happens if it is left empty.

props.name: error
props.note: What is wrong, in the same place as the helper and in the error colour.

entries.name: FieldLine
entries.purpose: The small line a Field draws under a control — on its own, for the places where there is no single control to draw it under.

props.name: tone
props.note: `helper` (muted) is a hint; `warning` (amber) and `error` (red) are outcomes.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: FilePicker
entries.purpose: The browser's file picker, with nothing drawn.

props.name: onPick
props.note: The chosen files, in the order the picker gave them.

entries.name: Form
entries.purpose: The fields and the button that sends them.

props.name: onSubmit
props.note: Enter in a field, or a submit button. The page's own submit is already prevented.

props.name: busy
props.note: While sending: every field and button inside is switched off, and focus waits on the form.

props.name: enterSends
props.note: Whether Enter in a one-line field sends.

entries.name: hueFor
entries.purpose: The colour a person's initials sit on, chosen from a key: the same key always gives the same hue, so a face reads as theirs in every app.

entries.name: IconButton
entries.purpose: A square button around a 16px icon: 4px padding, 8px radius, three variants.

props.name: variant
props.note: `current` takes the colour of what it sits in — the ✕ on a `Banner` wears the banner's tone.

props.name: pressed
props.note: On, like a Bold button while the selection is bold: the active fill, and `aria-pressed`.

props.name: glow
props.note: A glow in Signal — the send arrow while there is something to send.

props.name: tooltipShortcut
props.note: A key hint drawn as the `Kbd` chip inside the tooltip — for a button whose only other affordance is a keyboard shortcut.

props.name: disabledReason
props.note: Why the action cannot succeed right now.

props.name: href
props.note: A link that looks like an icon button: an anchor, so the address stays real for a modified click or a new tab, as `Link` keeps it.

props.name: children
props.note: The icon: 16px, stroke 1.5.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

props.name: relayUrl

props.name: onCopyKey

props.name: compact

props.name: children

entries.name: IdentityPanel

props.name: onClose
props.note: Called when a row asks the menu to close.

props.name: signedIn
props.note: Signed in through Estiva ID, as opposed to a browser-held key.

props.name: relayUrl
props.note: Names the workspace; absent hides the workspace section.

props.name: idBase
props.note: Estiva ID's base URL when this build offers sign-in; absent = anonymous-only build.

props.name: onCopyKey
props.note: "Copy public key" appears only when the app can supply one.

props.name: children
props.note: App-specific rows, drawn as their own group between the workspace section and the actions.

entries.name: INLINE_CHIP_CLASSES

entries.name: INLINE_CHIP_TONE_CLASSES

entries.name: InlineChip

props.name: icon

props.name: href

entries.name: inlineChipClassName
entries.purpose: The chip's classes for a tone, with anything the caller adds.

entries.name: InputChip

props.name: leading

props.name: onRemove

props.name: removeLabel

props.name: truncate

entries.name: TopBar
entries.purpose: The 52px top bar: `menu` and `logo` on the left, a `search` slot in the centre, the identity cluster on the right.

props.name: menu
props.note: Far left: the menu button, in an app whose navigation collapses.

props.name: logo
props.note: Beside the menu button: the app's logo mark, or its name as text.

props.name: search
props.note: The centre: a search field, or a launcher affordance — or nothing; the slot holds its place.

props.name: right
props.note: The right cluster — an `IdentityMenu` and its neighbours.

entries.name: useToast
entries.purpose: How anything under a `ToastProvider` raises a toast (`showToast`) or takes one away (`dismissToast`).

entries.name: WithTooltip
entries.purpose: A tooltip on something that cannot be its own trigger — a span, a `Chip`, an icon.

props.name: shortcut
props.note: Passed straight to the surface — see `TooltipProps.shortcut`.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.note: Extra classes on the wrapper — e.g. `min-w-0 shrink` so a truncating label keeps truncating inside it.

props.name: inline
props.note: For a trigger inside a line of text — a reference, a name in a sentence: the wrapper is a `<span>`, because a `<div>` is not allowed inside a paragraph (UIG-14, Katerina, 19 September).
